reason: A coding-agent orchestration plugin that runs isolated multi-model matches, validates and scores their changes, reviews diffs, and explicitly applies a selected winner.

summaries.zh: 用于在隔离的 Git worktree 中运行多模型编码对比、执行确定性验证、查看差异并显式应用获胜方案的智能体编排插件。
summaries.en: An agent orchestration plugin for running multi-model coding matches in isolated Git worktrees, validating and scoring changes, reviewing diffs, and explicitly applying a selected winner.

capabilities: Runs 2–4 configured coding agents in isolated Git worktrees
Executes Git and validation commands through a subprocess API
Validates and scores contestant changes deterministically
Persists match reports and supports cancellation and diff review
Explicitly applies a selected winner patch to the repository
